Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-calendars-00.

NOT WORKED in the JMAP-v9py compliance sweep; filed for a later session.

Capability: urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:calendars (meaningful only with both urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat AND urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars).

## Naming note

Workspace already has crate-jmap-calendars-* for the IETF draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 binding. This bead's crates would be named crate-jmap-chat-calendars-* to disambiguate from the IETF binding.

## What needs to land

- Space extension: calendarId (optional; references Calendar on same account)
- No new methods. Reuses JMAP Calendars methods.
- MessageAction "urn:jmap:chat:cap:calendar-event" semantics (uri forms, metadata keys: startsAt, endsAt, location, participantCount)
- MessageAction "urn:jmap:chat:cap:availability" semantics
- RSVP via existing CalendarEvent/set patch (no new method)
- Capability fields: mayBindCalendar, supportsIcsParsing, supportsAvailabilityLookup
- ICS auto-creation rules (default needs-action, size limits, rate limits)

## Dependencies

- crate-jmap-calendars-types must be stable (IETF binding; workspace already has it)
- jmap-chat-types Space extension shape
